title: Light Waves Visualized using Photon Sieves.
summary: Huygens Optics shows how DIY photon sieves shape a laser's wave front, explaining how they differ from zone plates and how aperture count affects the focal point, with time-resolved visualizations of the diffraction.
why: HN points to it for a clear explanation of photon sieves versus Fresnel lenses and for showing what interference patterns actually look like.

quote.text: It shows how the interference patterns actually look.
